name: agent-bus
description: Local message bus for agent-to-agent communication across Claude/Codex/Cursor sessions on the same machine. Adds the agent-bus MCP server (63 tools plus a Slack-style multi-project web cockpit, including async asks, team-scoped routing, tracked tasks, truncation-safe inbox previews, and activity timelines) and the universal coordinator skill. Optional Stop hook for listener resilience (off by default).

interface.longDescription: Coordinate work across multiple AI agent sessions on the same machine via a local SQLite-backed message bus. Register session names, delegate to helpers, get a second opinion, ask specialists by capability, message scoped teams, preview large inbox messages safely, open a Slack-style local web cockpit for projects, teams, chat, Kanban, activity, people, and attention items, broadcast to channels, track shared tasks, record task progress, show activity timelines and cockpit dashboards, set visible current work, record decisions, and generate review gates/final reports. Requires @agent-bus-connect/cli on PATH.
defaultPrompt: Register me on agent-bus and show who else is around.
Ask a reviewer to check my latest changes.
Delegate this to a helper and notify me when done.
Open the Slack-style local web cockpit for this project and team.
